'''Intel Agent 438432''' was an individual who worked as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. At some point during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] held a confidential meeting with [[Sub-Prefect]] [[Helkson Vall]] of [[Kalandis IV]]. During the meeting, Vall recounted to the agent the story of the [[Death/Legends|demise]] of the Imperial official [[Matagorn]] at the hands of the [[Srrors'tok]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tyionsis Cex]].<ref name="What's In A Name">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters|story=What's In A Name}}</ref>
